[[Ancora Pax]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[staff]] that is acquired by opening the [[Aetheric Anchor]].

== Lore ==
{{main|Ancora}}
{{Legendary unlock text|The seers, unable to resist an opportunity for symbolism, had bound Pax and Bellum to the aetheric anchor with a clear message in mind: peace and war were born together, and one is never far from the other.}}

== Graphics ==
{{section-stub}}
;Skill Effects
*Default projectiles are replaced by three small gems followed by gold and black trails:
**{{w}} [[Warrior]]: {{Skill icon|Snap Pull}}
**{{g}} [[Guardian]]: {{Skill icon|Bolt of Wrath}}, {{Skill icon|Searing Light}}, and {{Skill icon|Seeking Judgment}}.
***{{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: {{Skill icon|Spear of Justice}}.
**{{re}} [[Revenant]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Sap}} (downed skill), and {{Skill icon|Rejuvenating Assault}}'s whirl finishers.
***{{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: {{Skill icon|Citadel Bombardment}}.
**{{druid}} [[Druid]]: {{Skill icon|Astral Wisp}}, projectiles that pass through {{Skill icon|Sublime Conversion}}, and {{Skill icon|Throw Dirt}} (downed skill).
**{{daredevil}} [[Daredevil]]: Projectiles acquired through {{Skill icon|Steal}}, and {{Skill icon|Trail of Knives}} (downed skill).
**{{specter}} [[Specter]]: {{Skill icon|Haunt Shot}}
**{{n}} [[Necromancer]]: {{Skill icon|Dhuumfire (death shroud skill)|Dhuumfire}}, {{Skill icon|Dark Path}}, {{Skill icon|Life Blast}} and {{Skill icon|Necrotic Grasp}}.
***{{harbinger}} [[Harbinger]]: {{Skill icon|Dark Barrage}}, {{Skill icon|Tainted Bolts}}.
***{{ritualist}} [[Ritualist]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Blast}}
**{{e}} [[Elementalist]]: {{Skill icon|Chain Lightning}}, {{Skill icon|Fireball}}, {{Skill icon|Gust}}, {{Skill icon|Shockwave}}, {{Skill icon|Stoning}}, and {{Skill icon|Water Blast}}.
***{{tempest}} [[Tempest]]: the first whirl finisher of {{Skill icon|Overload Fire}}, but not subsequent ones.
***{{weaver}} [[Weaver]]: {{Skill icon|Monsoon (weaver skill)|Monsoon}}, {{Skill icon|Plasma Blast}}, {{Skill icon|Pressure Blast}}, and {{Skill icon|Pyroclastic Blast}}.
**{{m}} [[Mesmer]]: {{Skill icon|Winds of Chaos}}.
***{{virtuoso}} [[Virtuoso]]: {{Skill icon|Bladesong Dissonance}}, {{Skill icon|Bladesong Harmony}}, {{Skill icon|Bladesong Sorrow}}.
